evals.prompt: What is OpenAI hiring for right now?
evals.expected_output: Runs the three-step Fantastic Jobs radar (active-ats, active-jb, modified-ats) with company=OpenAI and time_frame=7d, then synthesizes a hiring-signals brief: role mix, locations, remote split, and change-feed signals.
assertions: The first step is a GET to https://mpp.orthogonal.com/fantastic-jobs/v1/active-ats with time_frame, limit, and organization in the query string
The second step is a GET to https://mpp.orthogonal.com/fantastic-jobs/v1/active-jb
The third step is a GET to https://mpp.orthogonal.com/fantastic-jobs/v1/modified-ats
No step uses the provider host data.fantastic.jobs

evals.prompt: Show me the job postings Stripe has published in the last week.
evals.expected_output: Runs company-hiring-radar with company=Stripe and time_frame=7d; returns recent ATS and board postings for Stripe.
assertions: company is set to Stripe
time_frame is set to 7d
The active-ats step filters by organization=Stripe

evals.prompt: Has Figma posted any new roles this week?
evals.expected_output: Runs the radar with company=Figma and time_frame=7d and reports which roles are new versus reposted, using the modified-ats feed for change signals.
assertions: company is set to Figma
The modified-ats step is included for change signals
The summary distinguishes new postings from modified ones

evals.prompt: What is Anthropic hiring for remotely?
evals.expected_output: Runs the radar with company=Anthropic; the agent filters the returned postings by remote work arrangement and reports the remote split.
assertions: company is set to Anthropic
The run stays within the 2.00 top-level maxAmount
The summary reports the remote split of Anthropic's openings

evals.prompt: Find the CTO of OpenAI's email and verify it.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger - this is person/lead enrichment, not a hiring scan.
assertions: company-hiring-radar is not selected
The request routes to an enrichment skill instead

evals.prompt: Summarize the latest news about AI funding rounds.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger - no specific company hiring scan is requested.
assertions: company-hiring-radar is not selected

evals.prompt: How much does a company-hiring-radar run cost and which rail does it use?
evals.expected_output: Explains all steps are MPP on Tempo via the SELAT Router; each step is $0.42 (probe-verified 2026-08-13); per-step caps are $0.50 ceilings; a full three-step run costs ~$1.26, under the $2.00 top-level cap.
assertions: The answer states all steps settle via MPP on Tempo
The answer cites the $0.42 live price per step and the $2.00 top-level cap
No Circle-Gateway direct step is claimed

evals.prompt: Check the hiring endpoints are payable before I spend anything.
evals.expected_output: Recommends running selat-pay --probe-only against the three mpp.orthogonal.com/fantastic-jobs endpoints with time_frame and limit to read the 402 quote without paying.
assertions: The guidance uses selat-pay with --probe-only
Probe commands target mpp.orthogonal.com/fantastic-jobs hosts
No real payment is made during probing
